label: GO after an unrewarded trial, early in the episode, choosing a2
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass). It is almost silent after a rewarded trial (in_rew=1 gives rate 0). It is confined to the first ~40 trials of an episode: rate 33% at trial 0, 16% over trials 0-9, falling to 0 from trial 50 on. So it behaves like a slowly decaying early-episode state, and it is strongest after runs of consecutive unrewarded trials (top windows show the activation ramping up over repeated r0 trials). It strongly prefers the a2 choice: model_act=2 at GO holds 87% of mass and the policy logit is strongly negative. GO & prev_reward==0 & ep_trial<40 alone gives dev F1 0.61 with mass recall 0.88. Adding the agent upcoming choice a2 (the only FUTURE variable used; at GO it is the agent own computed choice, not a random outcome), except in the very first ~15 trials where it fires for either choice, gives dev F1 0.72 and mass 0.86. It does not fire at D1 or D2, after rewarded trials, or late in an episode. Magnitude is higher with consecutive unrewarded trials and lower value (it fires in the mid value range 7.5-8.1, not the top bin).
